crypto_support.label: Crypto Support
crypto_support.headline: Crypto Customer Support Specialist | Web3 Support | Customer Success
crypto_support.summary: Bilingual English/Spanish crypto professional with 7+ years of hands-on experience in cryptocurrency and Web3, focused on self-custody, wallets, exchanges, blockchain transactions, DeFi and user education. Strong ability to troubleshoot crypto-related issues and translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for non-technical users. Experienced with wallet setup and recovery, network selection, gas fees, transaction troubleshooting, CEX/DEX workflows and crypto security. Combines technical curiosity, calm communication and a security-first mindset.

crypto_operations.label: Crypto Operations
crypto_operations.headline: Crypto Operations Associate | Web3 Operations | Crypto Support
crypto_operations.summary: Bilingual English/Spanish crypto professional with 7+ years of hands-on experience across cryptocurrency and Web3, with particular strength in wallets, exchanges, blockchain transactions, self-custody and operational troubleshooting. Experienced in navigating CEX and DEX environments, transferring assets across blockchain networks, identifying transaction and network issues, understanding fees and liquidity, and helping users operate safely within crypto platforms. Highly detail-oriented and systematic when evaluating financial and technical systems, with a strong focus on accuracy, risk awareness, security and process efficiency.

community.label: Web3 Community
community.headline: Web3 Community Specialist | Crypto Community & Support | User Education
community.summary: Bilingual English/Spanish crypto professional with 7+ years of hands-on involvement in cryptocurrency and Web3 communities, combining community participation, user education, technical communication and crypto research. Experienced in Telegram and Discord environments, helping users understand projects, wallets, transactions and Web3 concepts while maintaining a calm, security-conscious approach. Strong communicator with the ability to translate complex technical subjects into accessible language for newcomers, while remaining comfortable with crypto-native terminology and more experienced users.

junior_research.label: Junior Research
junior_research.headline: Junior Crypto Researcher | Web3 Research Assistant | Crypto Due Diligence
junior_research.summary: Bilingual English/Spanish crypto researcher with 7+ years of independent hands-on experience studying cryptocurrency, blockchain ecosystems and digital assets. Strongest areas include project due diligence, tokenomics, vesting schedules, market capitalisation, liquidity, project fundamentals, roadmaps, community analysis and risk assessment. Experienced in turning complex technical and financial information into structured explanations that non-specialists can understand. Looking to transition this extensive independent research experience into a junior research, research assistant or Web3 intelligence role.

customer_support.label: Customer Support (genérico)
customer_support.headline: Customer Support Specialist | Customer Experience | Bilingual EN/ES
customer_support.summary: Bilingual (English/Spanish) customer support professional with direct experience supporting 200-300 customers in financial products, objection handling, de-escalation and written communication, plus 7+ years of hands-on experience in crypto/Web3, payments, self-custody and technical troubleshooting. Strong at explaining complex financial and technical concepts clearly, security awareness (KYC, fraud, scams, phishing) and onboarding users. Calm, structured, solutions-oriented communication. Available immediately for remote roles with US/EU timezone overlap.

voice_ai.label: Voice & AI Audio
voice_ai.headline: Voice Talent · Audio Narration · AI Voice Data · Bilingual EN/ES
voice_ai.summary: Bilingual (English/Spanish) voice talent with a clear, calm and well-paced delivery, frequently praised for voice tone and clarity in both languages. Comfortable reading scripts, stories and long-form text for narration, audiobooks, video tours and AI voice training projects. Also experienced with AI tools, audio content workflows and transcription, with a strong attention to accuracy and detail.

ai_content.label: AI Content / Creative
ai_content.headline: AI Content Creator · Creative AI Workflows · Visual & Video Content
ai_content.summary: Creative professional with strong photography and cinema background, now producing content with AI tools: AI-assisted image and video generation, image editing, video editing, scripts and copywriting, voice-over and storytelling. Built custom Python/OpenAI API workflows for batch processing and quality control. Prompt engineering expert with a focus on consistency, realism and narrative structure. Bilingual EN/ES.

admin_ops.label: Admin / VA Básico
admin_ops.headline: Administrative Assistant · Virtual Assistant · Data Entry · Bilingual EN/ES
admin_ops.summary: Bilingual (English/Spanish) administrative professional with experience in customer records, data management, spreadsheets and office operations, plus strong technical troubleshooting skills from an IT apprenticeship. Highly organised, detail-oriented and thorough, with a reputation for reliability and care in every task. Comfortable with Google Workspace, Excel/Sheets, scheduling, inbox management and documentation. Immediate availability for remote work.
